findings.title: Bind sample configuration to its import result
findings.why_it_matters: The pending sample flag is fulfilled by any idle view. If a sample import fails while a previous dataset is open, Session keeps that old view, and the effect applies the bundled workflow to the old dataset. This also splits a single sample transaction across a button handler, a ref, and an effect, making future import failure handling easy to miss.
evidence: src/session/controller.ts:68:         this.update({ busy: "", view: m.view, error: "", recoverable: false });
findings.suggested_fix: Make sample import and configuration one Session operation or return an import completion result carrying the new dataset ID. Configure the bundled workflow only after that specific import succeeds; clear pending sample state on error. Add a browser test with an existing file, a failed sample import, and verification that the existing mapping remains active.
